title: Legal Name Changes of the Filed Driver — Cardinal Financial Responsibility Filing Desk Reference
content:
## Subject

A name amendment tells the ordering state the filed driver's new legal name, exactly as the reissued license prints it, when the customer reports a legal name change. It applies to every Cardinal Financial Responsibility Filing certificate. The legal name recorded is the one printed on the reissued license, never a nickname or a name the license does not yet show.

The name amendment charge is the amount booked for it, once per name amendment, on its transmission.

## Condition on the filing's record

A name amendment charge is not worked out until every policy bound for the named insured after the certificate was requested is named on the filing's record by a policy-number amendment.

Restated: so long as any policy bound for the named insured after the filing's requested date is not named by a policy-number amendment on the filing's record, the name amendment charge is not worked out.

## What the name amendment records

- the full name on the record of the driver the filing certifies is replaced by the new legal name;
- one amendment entry on the filing's record with the reason name change;
- one amendment transmission to the ordering state under a new transmission confirmation number;
- one filing charge with the reason amended filing on that transmission, in the amount given.

The filing's status does not change. The customer sees the new name on the driver record and the amendment and its charge on the filing history.

## Invocation

**Tool:** `amend_certificate_name_9daa06e9` — an agent-side tool; the representative unlocks it and then calls it.

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `filing_id` | The filing reference number of the certificate being amended, as returned by the filing lookup for the household | Identifier |
| `legal_name` | The filed driver's new full legal name exactly as the customer reads it from the reissued driver's license | Verbatim: the same spelling, spacing, capitalization and punctuation, character for character |
| `name_amendment_charge` | The name amendment charge to book | USD, non-negative, two decimal places; rounded to the cent on entry |

The tool records the charge it is given and does not calculate it.

### Return

A confirmation sentence naming the filing reference number, the name now on the driver record, the new transmission confirmation number of the amendment (text beginning with SRT-) and the charge booked in USD with two decimal places. Receiving it means the amendment and its charge were recorded. No other return or error is defined.

## Illustration (hypothetical)

A license reissued as "Mary-Ellen O'Connor Reyes" is entered as `legal_name` = Mary-Ellen O'Connor Reyes — not "Mary Reyes", and not "Mary Ellen O'Connor-Reyes".
